statement: Run an .scr text file as command-line input, one command per line, where blank spaces and blank lines act as Enter, semicolon lines are comments and the last line must be blank.
superiority: Scripts run in a sandbox with step-through and dry-run.

acceptance.sketch: Script containing LINE 0,0 10,0 (blank line) creates a line; semicolon comment ignored; filename in SCRIPT prompt.

notes: Verified against help page "SCRIPT (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-95BB6824-0700-4019-9672-E6B502659E9E | prior app hint: cand2 app registers RunScript, LoadScript; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Support RSCRIPT to repeat a running script, Esc to stop it, RESUME to continue an interrupted script, and DELAY with a millisecond argument to pause between script steps.

source.ref: To Create a Script that Preloads Slides

acceptance.sketch: RSCRIPT loops endlessly until Esc; DELAY 1000 waits about 1 second; RESUME resumes after pause.

notes: Verified against help page "To Create a Script that Preloads Slides". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: In scripts, use the dialog-free hyphen forms of commands, and have file dialogs fall back to command-line prompts while a script is active (FILEDIA), keeping in mind CMDECHO only controls echo for the LISP command function.

acceptance.sketch: Script uses -LAYER and -INSERT without dialogs; FILEDIA reset at end.

notes: Verified against help page "FILEDIA (System Variable)". Corrected: CMDECHO affects only the AutoLISP command function, not scripts; FILEDIA already prompts at the command line while a script runs. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E7599129-5A3B-4121-A0C3-A625CA96E55B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-95BB6824-0700-4019-9672-E6B502659E9E Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Run a script at startup with the /b switch alongside startup switches such as /nologo, and support a core-console mode started with accoreconsole taking /i drawing, /s script and /product switches.

acceptance.sketch: accoreconsole /i dwg /s file.scr produces the same DWG as GUI run.

notes: Verified against help page "Command Line Switch Reference". Corrected: For the main executable /s names support folders, not a script; /s script and /product belong to accoreconsole. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8675B657-8C15-4594-BDFB-644B66BD02D7 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/OARX/2025/ENU/?guid=AUTOCAD_CORE_CONSOLE Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Process many drawings in a batch by driving scripts that open, save and close each drawing, or by running the core console over a list of files.

acceptance.sketch: Script opens 5 files, runs PURGE, saves and closes; all 5 files modified time updated.

notes: UNVERIFIED: No help page documents an OPEN/QSAVE/CLOSE batch-driver pattern; the core console page only states it is for batch processing multiple drawings. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-95BB6824-0700-4019-9672-E6B502659E9E Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Treat script text as typed command-line responses, requiring quoted long file names and a blank final line, assuming PICKADD 1 and PICKAUTO 0, and undoing a whole script with one U.

acceptance.sketch: Bad coordinate string causes script to stop with message at the offending line.

notes: Verified against help page "About Command Scripts". Corrected: The page does not describe how invalid lines or errors are handled; only the blank-last-line rule and the other behaviors listed here are documented. Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Allow LISP expressions embedded in script lines starting with a parenthesis to be evaluated.

acceptance.sketch: Script line (setq a 5) then CIRCLE 0,0 !a evaluates a.

notes: UNVERIFIED: Not stated in the script pages; the Action Recorder page says a script can be used to load AutoLISP, ObjectARX, VBA or .NET files. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FEAD3614-CD33-4B60-BC00-4CBC98D8CBCB Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Lisp; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Record entered commands and inputs with the Action Recorder using ACTRECORD and ACTSTOP, saving them as action macro files (ACTM/ACTMX) that can be played back.

acceptance.sketch: RECSCRIPT records typed commands to a file; RECSTOP ends.

notes: Verified against help page "ACTRECORD (Command)". Corrected: RECSCRIPT and RECSTOP do not appear in the help; recording is ACTRECORD/ACTSTOP into action macros. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-94B6E003-B7BF-4A65-8E62-AF92D757C43B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FEAD3614-CD33-4B60-BC00-4CBC98D8CBCB Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: cand2 app registers RecordMacro; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Allow -PLOT, PLOT, -PUBLISH and PUBLISH to run from scripts, publishing from an existing DSD sheet list and processing in the foreground regardless of BACKGROUNDPLOT.

acceptance.sketch: Script prints to PDF named file.

notes: Verified against help page "-PUBLISH (Command)". Corrected: Batch Plot as a separate tool is not documented; the help covers -PLOT, -PUBLISH with DSD files, and foreground processing in scripts. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-625E395D-143A-494F-A1EA-1BF119B927DC ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-713029B7-B5AC-4860-BE2E-74878D418EA4 Acceptance sketch predates this review and was not re-checked. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Restrict script files from network paths and other executable file types to trusted folders per SECURELOAD and TRUSTEDPATHS, and require explicit paths for startup /b scripts in the Start In folder unless LEGACYCODESEARCH or /six permits.
notes: Verified against help page "SECURELOAD (System Variable)". Corrected: SECURELOAD lists SCR files from network paths specifically, and TRUSTEDPATHS lists SCR among covered file types.
